teaser.en: Bite a leaf and you taste the sea: this succulent shrub is so salty that only hardy livestock will browse it.
teaser.sw: Ng'ata jani lake na utaonja bahari: kichaka hiki chenye majani manono kina chumvi nyingi kiasi kwamba ni mifugo hodari tu wanaokila.
teaser.dg: Ng'ata kodza na undaonja bahari: chitsaka chichi cha madzi-madzi china munyu sana hata ni mifugo yenye nguvu tu inayoweza kuchirya.

summary.en: Seablite is a salty, succulent shrub of the landward mangrove edge and the bare saline flats behind it. Where it grows it often takes over, forming low grey-green thickets where little else survives.
summary.sw: Mwinyonye ni kichaka chenye chumvi na majani manono kinachoota ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu na kwenye nyanda tupu za chumvi zilizo nyuma yake. Pale kinapoota mara nyingi hutawala, na kuunda vichaka vifupi vya kijivu-kijani mahali ambapo mimea mingine michache huweza kuishi.
summary.dg: *Seablite* ni chitsaka chenye munyu na cha madzi-madzi cha kanda ya bara ya mikoko na tsi za weru zenye munyu nyuma ya mikoko. Phatu chinaphomera kpwa kawaida chinaenea, chichihenda vitsaka vifupi vya rangi ya ivu na chijani ambapho mimea michache yanjina inaweza kumera.

about.en:
Seablite is a low, much-branched shrub with small, fleshy, almost cylindrical leaves packed along its stems. The leaves store water and salt, which lets the plant survive on ground that would kill most others. Its flowers are tiny and greenish and easy to overlook.

Where conditions suit it, seablite is often the dominant plant, covering patches of the flats in a single dense stand.
about.sw:
Mwinyonye ni kichaka kifupi chenye matawi mengi, na majani madogo, manono, karibu ya umbo la mrija, yaliyosongamana kando ya mashina yake. Majani huhifadhi maji na chumvi, jambo linalouwezesha mmea kuishi katika ardhi ambayo ingeua mimea mingine mingi. Maua yake ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani, na ni rahisi kutoyaona.

Pale hali inapoufaa, mwinyonye mara nyingi ndio mmea unaotawala, ukifunika sehemu za nyanda kama kundi moja lililosongamana.
about.dg:
*Seablite* ni chitsaka chifupi chenye panda nyinji, chenye makodza madide, ga madzi-madzi, ganayokala dza mirija, ganayobanana kanda-kanda ya mihiye. Makodza ganaika madzi na munyu, na chitu hichi chinaricha mmea umere kpwenye tsi ambayo inaolaga mimea minji. Maruwage ni madide sana na ga chijani, na ni rahisi kugatsupa usigaone.

Phatu phanaphochifwaha, *seablite* kpwa kawaida ndio mmea unaozidi phapho, chichifwinika seemu za tsi kpwa fungu rimwenga ririrogbwirana.

where.en: It grows on the landward side of the mangroves and on saline flats, the open, salt-crusted ground that the highest tides flood only now and then. Walk inland from the mangroves at Gazi or Vanga and it is one of the plants that marks the change from mud to dry land.
where.sw: Huota upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko na kwenye nyanda za chumvi, ardhi iliyo wazi na yenye ukoko wa chumvi ambayo hufurika mara moja moja tu na maji makuu kabisa. Ukitembea kuelekea bara kutoka mikokoni huko Gazi au Vanga, ni mojawapo ya mimea inayoonyesha mpaka kati ya tope na nchi kavu.
where.dg: Chinamera uphande wa bara wa mikoko na kpwenye tsi za weru zenye munyu, tsi yenye munyu dzuluye ambayo madzi ga kuodzala makulu sana ganaifwinika wakati wanjina tu. Uchinyendeka kula mikoko kuphiya bara kuko Gazi au Vanga, ni kahi ya mimea inayoonyesa phatu matope ganaphomala na tsi kavu inaphoandza.

uses.en: It is used as fodder, though it is very salty. Inland, pastoralists use it to feed their animals.
uses.sw: Hutumika kama lishe ya mifugo, ingawa kina chumvi nyingi sana. Huko bara, wafugaji hukitumia kulisha wanyama wao.
uses.dg: Chinahumirwa dza chakurya cha mifugo, hata chichikala china munyu sana. Bara, atu anaofuga mifugo anachihumira kurisa mifugo yao.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mwinyonye*, and it is also called *mwinamia maji*. In English it is seablite, and its scientific name is *Suaeda monoica*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili kinaitwa *mwinyonye*, na pia huitwa *mwinamia maji*. Kwa Kiingereza kinaitwa *seablite*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Suaeda monoica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwinyonye*, na piya chinaihwa *mwinamia maji*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *seablite*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Suaeda monoica*.
